raw_segments.text: But how did I murder her? Is that how men do murders? Do men go to commit a murder as I went then?
I will tell you someday how I went. Did I murder the old woman? I murdered myself, not her.
I crushed myself once for all forever.
But it was the devil that killed that old woman. Not I enough enough, Sonya enough. Let me be."
He cried in a sudden spasm of agony. Let me be.
